proposed_status_reason: Base-case unlevered cap rate of 9.0% is below the 10% threshold using documented 2025 STR gross revenue ($53,000) and estimated operating expenses. Special assessments remain UNKNOWN (cannot assume $0 per Fla. Stat. §718.116 estoppel requirement). HOA is ESTIMATED at $660/mo from a comparable unit and requires estoppel verification. Even with optimistic rent ($4,800/mo) and 15% management fee, cap rate reaches only ~10.6%; base case with verified income and standard 20% STR management falls short. Any confirmed special assessment or higher HOA would further reduce returns.

base_case.notes: Documented 2025 STR gross revenue with 20% management and estimated HOA

optimistic_rent.notes: High-end rent ($4,800/mo) with 20% management; marginal 10% threshold

low_management.notes: 15% management fee with documented rent; still below 10%

self_managed.notes: Eliminates professional management; not representative of hands-off STR investment at Laketown Wharf

breakeven_analysis.notes: Need $2,820 additional annual NOI (5.3% expense reduction or 5.3% rent increase) to reach 10% cap rate at $279,000 purchase price

risk_factors: Special assessments UNKNOWN — 2008 building may have deferred capital needs; estoppel certificate required
HOA fee ESTIMATED from comparable unit 913; actual amount may differ
STR management fee (20% of gross) is a major expense driver at $10,600/year
Documented $53,000 gross is actual 2025 performance but STR income is inherently variable year-to-year
Property taxes and insurance are estimated pending title search and HO-6 quote verification
